text:
jo: Quick heads-up — I'm publishing py/ts SDK v1.2.0 in tonight's change window. npm and pypi push started.
maya: 👍 link?
jo: https://registry.redwood.example/@redwood/sdk-ts shows 1.2.0, pip shows 1.2.0, but docs site API table still lists 1.1.9.
publish-bot: publish attempt 1751112222 by jo
publish-bot: outcome: success (npm & pypi artifacts published)
ryan: hmm. docs site reads a pinned submodule of the sdk docs for the API table. maybe that wasn't updated during docs deploy.
maya: that would confuse customers who click from release notes to docs. We have three options: rollback npm, force docs redeploy with updated submodule, or add a banner in docs. I prefer redeploy + banner short-term. No yank unless unavoidable.
jo: agreed. I'll trigger a docs deploy and we can purge CDN if cache bites us.
ryan: triggering: `docs-deploy trigger --repo docs-site --ref main`
publish-bot: docs deploy kicked 1751112300 by ryan
docs-bot: docs deploy 1751112380 outcome: partial (search/index still showed old cached API table)
maya: looks like CDN cached the /sdk/reference pages. Need Cloudflare purge for those paths.
ryan: running: `cf purge --zone redwood --glob "/sdk/reference/*"` -> done
docs-bot: purge recorded 1751112440
jo: recheck — API table now reports 1.2.0. Confirmed.
maya: Phew. For release notes: product asked to include deprecation note for legacy sync-client and provide a migration snippet. Also request that examples pin to ~1.2.0 so they don't accidentally pull older peer deps.
jo: opened PR #420 for release notes + migration guide.
release-bot: release notes PR 420 created 1751112480
maya: Follow-up item: add a failsafe to the release pipeline that validates docs reflect the published version. If mismatch, pipeline should automatically add a temporary dist-tag (eg. v1.2.0-hold) and notify #releases.
jo: +1. I'll file the infra ticket.
ryan: filed INFRA-908: docs-version-check + dist-tag hold on mismatch. Assigning to release infra team.
maya: For today, no rollback required, docs fixed, release notes PR up. Let's keep an eye on examples and the CDN TTL.
jo: final: publishing completed, no yank, follow-ups created. Thanks all. :rocket:
